method: Headless Microsoft Edge via Playwright; real UI actions and real TEST API. Selected 503 responses injected by browser routing for recovery scenarios; remaining requests passed to TEST API. Read-only DOM inspection and authenticated API readback used for verification.
result: UX-01 fixed in local source and verified with real Edge UI against TEST backend; deployment to hosted TEST frontend not performed.

findings.title: Comment required error remains after correcting empty input
findings.expected: Clear required error and aria-invalid after valid content is entered
findings.actual: Red border, aria-invalid=true and Vui lòng nhập phản hồi remain until successful submission
findings.impact: Misleading validation feedback; sending valid content still succeeds
findings.rootCause: onChange={setContent} changes content without resetting empty state.
findings.fix: Required error depends on both a previously rejected blank submission and current trimmed content. Valid content clears the error immediately; clearing content after rejection shows it again.

create: past due date, incomplete date and date range corrections

performance.limits: Single local headless-browser sample. Not a load test, statistical benchmark, or real mobile device test.

regression.command: npm test -- tests/request-create.test.tsx tests/request-attachments.test.tsx tests/ticket-discussion.test.tsx tests/pending-attachments.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2

limits: Only nhandt01 used. Multi-account permission matrix and approval lifecycle not exercised.
General attachment upload at processed statuses 2/3/6 not exercised; upload coverage here is creation and comment/reply attachments.
Real uploads covered TXT and PNG. PDF/DOCX/XLSX, Excel import/export and exact 50 MiB successful upload not exercised.
Network/server failures were controlled 503 simulations, not actual server incidents.
Responsive viewport checks used desktop headless Edge; real device IME/keyboard, light theme and sustained load were not tested.
originalTestResult: One confirmed UX finding; tested creation, attachments, discussion, recovery, duplicate submission and responsive scenarios otherwise passed.
